interpretation.countsAreNotCauses: Counts partition where a threshold crossed. A during-body crossing can follow mostly pre-entry lateness. S=D+1.9I,E=D+2.1I yields before0/during1 without establishing render cause.
interpretation.sleep: Request/observed return include async suspension, executor resumption and observer work; no kernel wake timestamp.
interpretation.heterogeneity: ARM skipped-cycle lateness is mostly present at observed sleep return, while Intel additionally has many long actual tick calls; neither implies a common scheduler or renderer repair.
interpretation.observer: Per-run locks/stores can affect current sleep/yield and later cycles. No uninstrumented counterfactual.
interpretation.nextMissingBoundary: Ready-versus-running scheduling around late returns; per-phase same-thread CPU versus elapsed/CI wait within Intel long bodies. Existing aggregate CPU/kernel/resource metrics do not identify those causes.
interpretation.limits: Original #92 capacity failures and Intel1380s deadline/pending second inspection remain. No waveform sync, universal hardware capacity or uplink qualification.
